description: Checks one factual claim against the live web and returns {verdict, explanation, sources}, where verdict is supported, contradicted or unclear, usually in 4 to 9 seconds. Write the claim as a plain statement such as 'The Eiffel Tower is in Berlin' and split a compound claim into separate calls. Use research.answer for open questions. For several claims, call once per claim. Read-only. Paid per call with x402; a failed call is not charged.

claim.description: The factual claim to check, 1 to 500 characters, written as a statement.
claim.title: Claim

name: research.factcheck

explanation.description: One or two sentences on why.

verdict.description: How the live web treats the claim.
